messages.author: 024b138ef44fcdbc
messages.subject: NBLAST online problem
parts:
Hi all,

I have a problem with NBLAST online. When I follow the example from video about "TH-M-300005" or fru-M-200266 in "One against all", I get the following error message:

Error: An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification.

I have attached the picture of the screen.

Also, I am trying to load my skeletonized neuron in .swc file to "Upload a tracing" but I get the same error message.

Any help with resolving my problem would be highly appreciated!

Thank you!

Kind regards,

Altyn

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: NBLAST online problem
parts:
Dear Altyn, I'm afraid you're not the only user to hit this since last week. We're working the lead VFB developer to try to get the web app running again. If you want to try running on your desktop (perhaps using the docker image https://hub.docker.com/repository/docker/natverse/r-natverse/) you should be able to run the same searches. Details here http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/www/nblast_desktop/.

All the best, Greg.

If I select the template brain first and upload the file afterwards, I don't get the error message. But nothing happens once I click "NBLAST".

I tried to refresh the page several times and also tried to run it on mozilla firefox, chrome and Safari.

Do you by chance have any advice on that?


Thank you very much in advance!

Kind regards,
Lea
